input_domain: every textual BibEntry value emitted into the intermediary YAML
rule: Serialize every value unconditionally as a JSON string literal, which is also a valid YAML double-quoted scalar, and preserve its logical string value on parse
scope: The shared scalar serializer used by title, author and every optional textual field of the BibEntry to hayagriva bridge
preserved: YAML typed spellings in any case
forbidden: raw control characters inside a quoted scalar
